content: Local-first telemetry patterns (TelemetryDeck privacy FAQ, telemetry-kit compliance docs, Linux Foundation telemetry policy): collect only explicitly enumerated fields, no PII/identifiers, no automatic collection, local storage by default with explicit opt-in for any sharing, documented retention limits, and a deletion path. For a single-user desktop tool this reduces to an allowlist-only local ledger with schema disclosure, kill switch, and no network code path.
